Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from us for this game. We hope you enjoyed our coverage. There wasn't much of a contest most of the times but that is how international cricket is at this moment. There are many lopsided contests happening. Hopefully the ODIs will be more competitive. The first of which will be played on 20th August in Dambulla. Action begins at 1430 local time (0900 GMT). We look forward to your company. Until then, it's goodbye and take care!

India skipper, Virat Kohli calls it a good win for them. Says that it is nice to get convincing victories. On the positives, Kohli replies that Pandya's confidence with the bat and ball is the biggest positive as it gives them a lot of balance. Credits Rahane, Pujara, Mukund, Rahul for their knocks. Is more than happy with the efforts of the bowlers. Opines that they look forward to play every Test with the same excitement. Says that they want to be prepared, be proactive and need to carry this forward to be a ruthless side. On Sri Lankan players, he responds that they didn't have momentum on their side and they need to believe and not lose motivation to work hard.

Man of the Series, Shikhar Dhawan jokes that he was in Hong Kong enjoying his holidays, when asked about his place in the side before the series. Admits that he got a chance since an opener was injured. Adds that he is happy that things went well and he got this award. Affirms the backing he had of the team management. He states that he tries to play the attacking game which is his natural game. Ends by saying that he needs to keep working hard as there is competition for spots in the team and so nothing is a given.

Sri Lanka skipper, Dinesh Chandimal feels that one can't control the toss. Calls it a tough series as a team. Credits India for playing really well. Says that bad fielding is a part of the game but feels that they did not bat and bowl well. On the call to play the extra bowler, he replies that they wanted to restrict India under 450. Rues the batting and bowling lapses, does not think they concentrated well enough. Hopes that the talented players come good in the Pakistan tour.

Man of the Match, Hardik Pandya expresses gratitude and says that he's pretty glad that he has got his hundred here. Adds that the situation was good and he had the confidence to play his shots. He states that they as a team always had a target in mind and were looking to get somewhere around 550. He reckons that he has been bowling well and it isn't easy to get a five-fer in the longest format of the game. Further adds that he doesn't think too much about where he should bat and is happy to bat wherever the team wants. Ends by lauding the team and support staff.

Mohammed Shami led the attack well with the new ball. Ravichandran Ashwin and Kuldeep Yadav showed their class and took wickets at regular intervals. They were always in control with the Sri Lankan batsmen not providing a fight. Virat Kohli will be pleased with the way his side has played in the series. Stay with us as we bring you the presentation in a while.

Once the Indian lower order wagged yet again, Sri Lankan shoulders dropped along with their confidence and energy levels. Hardik Pandya's onslaught ripped the spirits out of them. From there, mentally, the hosts were shut out of the match. Only Dinesh Chandimal fought hard in the first innings and in the second it was only his and Mathews' stand that had something to be spoken about. Rest was all about the Indian bowlers going about their work professionally.

It should be noted that Kohli wasn't keen on the follow-on, but his teammates egged him to do so and the visitors ended up inflicting another innings defeat on the home side. It seemed that Sri Lanka never turned up to play this series. The last time they were in this Test was when they finished day one restricting the tourists to 329/6. Shikhar Dhawan and KL Rahul had set it up for the visiting side with a 188-run stand.

Another series win under Virat Kohli and this has been a comprehensive one. It proved to be a meek surrender from the Lankans as they batted over 80 overs only once in the entire series - just sums up their lack of application and temperament. This also is the first ever 3-0 whitewash away from home in Tests for India, seventh time a home team has been blanked 3-0.

Around middle and leg, defended off the back foot.
Tossed up around off, Sandakan looks to defend. But he gets an inside edge towards leg gully.
This one's played through mid-wicket for a run.
Googly around off, it stayed a tad low as Dickwella blocked it off the back foot.
Another ball given some air outside off, Sandakan gets an inside edge as he prods forward in defense. The ball falls in front of short leg.

Tossed up outside off, played to point.

Bowled around leg, he misses the ball and gets hit on the pads.

29 overs, 63 runs, 3 wickets - These are the numbers that matter for this session. India started on the right note by sending back the overnight batsmen back to the hut early. Shami bowled a probing spell and the hosts were left searching for answers. They would find solace from the fact that they didn't end up losing a cluster of wickets to him in that spell. Chandimal and Mathews have done well to guard their wickets since drinks. Join us in a while for the resumption of the Lankan vigil as they stand 270 runs behind India at this moment.
Fullish and straight on this occasion, Mathews clips it to mid-wicket. THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 3!
Similar length delivery in the off stump channel, Angelo hops and taps it to the off side.
Good length delivery around off, Mathews shuffles across and blocks it.
On a length and angling in from outside off. Chandimal gets squared up as he looks to work it to the leg side. Ends up getting a leading edge to covers for a single.

Back of a length outside off, Mathews plays it with an open face to point.
Mathews is on the move as he turns it through mid on for a run.
On middle and leg, Mathews clears his front leg and looks to block it but misses to get hit low on that pads. The ball lobs to short leg who takes it and appeals casually. There was no bat involved.
Takes a stride forward and eases it through extra cover for a run.
Floated around off, Dinesh takes a couple of steps down the track and looks to push it but gets a thick inside edge to leg gully.
Slower through the air, Chandimal strides forward and blocks it.
Waits for this one and defends it to short leg.
Axar Patel is on the field for Mohammed Shami.
That one jagged back substantially! On a length outside off, stays low. Mathews covers his off stump and lets it go. It swings in late. Saha moves to his left and dives to make a good stop.
Fuller length delivery outside off, Mathews comes half-forward and defends it.
Yadav bowls this one a bit fuller outside off, Angelo takes a confident stride forward and taps it to the off side.
Similar length delivery around off, not much nip on that. Mathews defends it solidly.
On a length on off, Angelo hangs back and defends it stoutly.
Full length delivery outside off, pushed crisply off the front foot to wide mid off.

Time for Drinks. Another hour where India assert their position in the match by snapping up regular wickets. Sri Lanka lost three in this hour and the talk in their camp would be to prevent or delay this slide.
This tossed up delivery is pushed gently to mid on by shimmying down a bit.
Gently floats it around middle, Chandimal gets wristy as he plays it on the on side.
This flighted ball is blocked off the front foot.
FOUR! Gloriously struck! Tossed up shorter delivery outside off, Chandimal gets back and punches it through covers for a boundary.
Tossed up ball outside off, Dinesh goes back and blocks it off the back foot.
Loopy ball down the leg side, left alone.
Another length ball outside off is shouldered arms to.
Bowled full around off, he knocked that away towards mid on. Kuldeep stops that well to prevent any run.
Length ball around off, pushed through covers for a run.
This ball is bunted on to the ground.
Full ball outside off, left alone.
Fuller ball outside off, driven wide of mid off for a brace.
Umesh Yadav comes on for a bowl.
This loopy ball is played to mid on for a run.
Tossed up around off, Chandimal again misses the sweep and gets hit on his pads. The Indians appeal but the umpire stays put. Ashwin signals to Kohli that impact was outside off.
Flighted ball outside off, pushed to the left of mid off for a quick run. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
This time Chandimal sweeps the full ball to deep square leg for a run.

Loopy ball around off, Chandimal goes for the sweep and misses. The ball hits him on the pad which interests the Indians who appeal. The umpire stays unmoved. The Indians think of a review, but the impact made them go against it. Snicko returns a spike as the ball passes the glove.
Tossed up ball outside off, Dinesh looks to defend but wears it on his pads.
Again he bowls it straighter on the stumps, Mathews collects a couple more through square leg.
Length ball on his pads is easy runs, as Mathews plays it through square leg for a couple.
Outswinging length ball outside off, left alone.
FOUR! STREAKY STROKE! A tad fuller around off, Mathews pushes at it without any feet movement. The ball takes the edge and rolls in the gap between the gully and the slip cordon for a boundary.
Length ball around off, blocked off the back foot.
This bouncer is ducked under by Angelo.
Chandimal looks to flick this flighted ball but got hit on his pads.
Flatter ball around off, punched off the back foot to the off side for a run.
Flighted ball around off, bunted on to the ground.
Floated delivery around off, played towards covers for a quick run.
This floated ball is blocked by getting behind the line of the ball.
Tossed up delivery outside off is played from within the crease.
Back of a length ball outside off, moving away just that little bit. Mathews gets squared up and sees the ball pass the edge of his bat. Beautiful spell of seam bowling by Shami.
Angelo Mathews strides out to the center with Lanka in disarray yet again.

OUT! Shami gets his revenge! Mendis has to walk back now. Length ball around off and middle, angling in to the batsman and swinging in a bit. He looks to flick but misses and gets rapped on the pads. Once that happens, the appeal and the finger-raising is just a formality, which is completed to end his stay at the crease. It looked plumb to the naked eye, but Hawk Eye showed that it just clipped the leg stump. There wasn't a need even to think about reviewing that.
FOUR! Beautifully played! Shorter delivery outside off, Mendis goes on to the back foot and cuts it to the left of point for a boundary. Good to see this.
Fuller ball outside off, driven to mid off.
Inswinging length ball around off, played from within the crease.
Back of a length ball around middle, knocked to mid-wicket.
Floated around off, Dinesh gets back and defends.
This flighted delivery is defended off the front foot.
Tossed up ball around off bounces a tad. Mendis looks to sweep initially but then plays it past short leg for a run.
Another loopy ball blocked off the front foot.
Tossed up delivery around off, Mendis plays it with soft hands towards mid-wicket.
Bowled down the leg side, Kusal tries a sweep but misses.
Length ball in line of the stumps, defended.
This time Dinesh gets behind the line of the ball and blocks.
Fuller ball around off, pushed towards covers off the front foot.
Shami welcomes Chandimal with a bouncer! The skipper ducks under that.
Skipper Dinesh Chandimal walks in. Can he bat out time?

OUT! The wonderful seam position from Shami yields him a wicket now. Length ball, slightly on the fuller side just outside off and gets some away movement. Pushpakumara just pokes at it and ends up edging the ball which Saha gobbles up. Too good a delivery to a nightwatchman.
Fuller ball around off, defended off the back foot.
Tossed up around off, driven back towards the bowler.
This ball is blocked to short leg.
Overpitched outside off, squirted to short third man for a run, to get off the mark.
This is floated around middle, Malinda misses the defense and the ball goes of his pad to short leg.
Slightly more air given by Ashwin this time, Pushpakumara bunts it on to the ground.
Tosses this around off, Kusal sweeps it all along the ground through square leg for a single.
This length ball outside off is driven straight to the cover fielder.
A back of a length ball around off and middle, blocked off the back foot.
Silly mid on in place.
Length ball this time around middle, pushed gently to the leg side.
Another fuller ball around off, edged towards gully.
Short cover in place now.
Fuller delivery outside off, it nips away after pitching, beating the poke of the batsman.
Bowls it on a length on off, Pushpakumara defends.
Wonderful drive through wide mid off for this loopy ball outside off. It fetches him a couple.
Flatter delivery outside off, pushed to point.
Kusal flicks this floater to the leg side.
Loopy ball around off, Mendis covers the stumps and blocks.
FOUR! Shot! Flatter but shorter ball around off and middle, Mendis picks up the length early and half-pulls it away over backward square leg for a boundary.
Floated ball around middle, nudged to the leg side.
This ball outside off is played to covers.
A good ball outside off, Malinda plays and misses.
Length ball on middle and leg, flicked straight to leg gully.
A length ball around off, played to point.
This is bowled on a length around off and middle, blocked again.
Length ball around off, blocked off the front foot.
Front foot defense to a loopy ball around off and middle.
This one's bowled on middle and turning in, the ball lobs off Mendis' pad and lands in the hands of short leg. An appeal follows only to be turned down.
Floated ball around middle and leg, Mendis goes back and blocks it from within the crease. The ball could have gone on to the stumps.
Kusal Mendis walks in next.

OUT! Excellent delivery to get early in the morning. Ashwin bowls it flatter around off, which the batsman had to play. Karunaratne gets on to the back foot and pokes his bat at that. The extra bounce means that the ball brushes his gloves and lobs straight into the waiting hands of Rahane at first slip. Not much different he could have done there.
Flighted ball around off, Karunaratne strides forward. Sees the ball go past the bat as it turns away.
Loopy ball around off and middle, blocked off the front foot.
R Ashwin is brought in to bowl.
Swinging delivery around off, Malinda again feels for it and sees the ball whiz past the edge.
He digs out the yorker around off. Shami oversteps, no ball.
Another length ball, blocked off the back foot.
Length ball outside off, Malinda feels for it and gets beaten.
Length ball, defended off the back foot.
Length ball down the leg side, he misses the flick and the ball falls just short of the diving Saha who gets some glove to that. Two byes taken.
Starts with a length ball around off angling in to the batsman, Pushpakumara misses the flick and gets hit on his pad. The Indians appeal but the umpire stays unmoved. This one's missing leg.
Mohammed Shami to bowl from the other end.

Googly this time, Dimuth strides forward to play for the conventional turn. He gets hit on the pad which draws an appeal from the Indians. No avail there. Hawk Eye shows that it would be missing the stumps.
This ball is given some air and bowled outside off, left alone.
Flatter ball, played to covers.

FOUR! First runs of the day, courtesy a boundary. Loopy full ball around  middle and leg, Karunaratne flicks it wide of mid on. Dhawan from mid on gives a valiant chase and puts in the dive as well, unsuccessfully.
A tad shorter this time, cut away to point.
Starts off with a tossed up delivery on off, which is pushed to covers off the front foot by Karunaratne.
We are ready to get rolling. Dimuth Karunaratne and Malinda Pushpakumara to continue their innings. Kuldeep Yadav to start off with the ball today. A slip and short leg in place. Here we go...

Pitch Report - Simon Doull, doing the pitch report reckons that there are a few visible cracks, but nothing alarming. There are rough patches around 2.5 m away from where the batsmen stand, he observes. He adds that he doesn't see much trouble for the batsmen.

Sri Lanka would aim to delay the inevitable. They have players who can show resilience and can bat out time. But capability counts for nothing if it doesn't translate into runs and performance. Stay with us as we get you all the action here.

Hello and welcome to our coverage of Day 3 of the third and final Test of the series between Sri Lanka and India in Kandy. The already high furling Indian flag would aim to furl higher as the team would look to finish the last rites today. This could be the first ever series whitewash away from home for the visitors.
... Day Three, Session One ...

Virat Kohli decided to enforce the follow-on and India continued to stamp their authority. The Sri Lankan openers adopted a circumspect approach but Umesh Yadav outfoxed Tharanga. The track is taking turn and is gripping as well and it will be a stern test for the hosts tomorrow. Join us to catch all the action from Day 3 at 1000 local (0430 GMT). Till then, cheers!

The Indian bowlers came out and piled the misery on the hosts. The Sri Lankan batsman tried hard but were found wanting against the testing lines and lengths. Only Chandimal was the one who showed some fight. Kuldeep Yadav was the star of the show as he picked up a 4-fer. He was supported well by Shami and Ashwin.

It has been a terrific day for India and they are all over the home side. Sri Lanka still trail by 333 runs and it will require a herculean effort on their part to bail themselves out of trouble. In the morning, India dominated the proceedings. It was Hardik Pandya who took the attack to the opposition and scored a terrific century.
Leg spinning delivery around leg and spinning away, Malinda defends off the back foot. THAT'S STUMPS, DAY 2!
This ball is given a lot of air and is played off the front foot onto the ground.
Floated delivery around off, defended showing the full face of the ground.
Flatter carrom ball around leg, strikes his pad as he misses the flick.
This loopy delivery is bunted on to the ground.
Tossed up ball outside off, Malinda blocks it firmly.
Change of ends for Ashwin. This will be the last over of the day.
Loopy ball outside off, driven to covers.
FOUR! That's dismissed from his presence. Shorter ball outside off, Karunaratne gets deep in his crease and cuts it to the left of the diving point fielder. The ball meets the fence rather quickly.
Loopy ball around off, blocked off the front foot.

Shorter ball around off, Karunaratne shapes to cut but the ball strikes his pad first before making a contact with the bat and rolls away towards point. The Indians appeal but the umpire stays unmoved.
This flighted ball outside off is smashed on to silly point's pad. The ball rolls towards covers.
Loopy full toss on his pads, flicked straight to mid-wicket.
Kuldeep Yadav is introduced into the attack. Can he sneak in another wicket today?
Peach of a delivery outside off, Pushpakumara gets squared up and is beaten.
Length ball on off, played from the crease.
Nightwatchman Malinda Pushpakumara walks out to bat.

OUT! Timber shattered! Umesh Yadav strikes as Tharanga departs for the second time today. The field placement from Kohli does the trick. There was a deep point in place for the batsman to take a single and get off strike and this greed has consumed the opener. Length ball just outside off, he tried to play in that region, instead gets an inside edge on to the off stump. Excellent thought process from India.
Length ball down the leg side, Upul misses the flick as the ball goes to the keeper.
A tad fuller around middle and off, pushed through mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball around off, played towards point for a run.
Dimuth solidly defends this loopy ball from the crease.
This flighted ball is driven straight to mid off.
Some more air to this ball, as Tharanga drives it through covers for a run.
Comes round the wicket and flights it around off, played off the outer half to backward point.
Loopy ball around off, front foot defense in display.
Tosses up from over the wicket, Tharanga gets back and defends.
He bowls it on a length on middle and leg, tucked away to square leg.
Length ball outside off, played to deep point for a run.
A tad fuller outside off, driven to covers.
Again a ball is met with the full face of the bat to block it.
Length ball around off, defended showing the full face of the bat.
Starts off with a back of a length ball around off. It strikes Tharanga on his thigh pad.
Umesh Yadav comes in for a burst.
Slower through the air, blocked off the front foot.
Tossed up ball, Karunaratne gets an inside edge onto his pads as he tries to defend.
This flighted ball is driven back to the bowler.
Loopy ball, driven straight to mid off.
Fired in on his pads, Karunaratne misses the flick as the ball goes to the keeper. The Indians appeal but to no avail.
Loopy ball, driven back to the bowler.
Fuller length ball outside off, left alone.
Length ball around middle, knocked away through mid-wicket for a run.
Too wide for Karunaratne to make any contact at that, he doesn't bother.
Back round the wicket, he bowls a length ball outside off, left alone.
That's a length ball that is punched to covers. Kohli there puts in a dive to prevent any run.
Bowls it on a length from over the wicket, Dimuth defends off the back foot.
Arm ball this time around off, Tharanga gets squared up and gets an outside edge as the ball rolls to point.
This ball's given some more air, Tharanga blocks it off the front foot.
Quicker ball around middle and leg, played to mid-wicket.
Loopy ball presented with the full face of the bat by Upul.
Loopy ball outside off, spins away as Tharanga half-prods at that and gets beaten.
Loopy ball on middle, he gets it off the inner half to the leg side.
Shortish ball outside off, punched off the back foot to the right of cover fielder who gets there and gives away no runs. Another maiden.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, flicked straight to mid-wicket.
Short ball outside off, DK sways away from that.
Fuller ball around off, defended on to the ground.
Karunaratne points his bat skywards to the length ball outside off.
Length ball around middle and leg, knocked to mid-wicket.
Some more air on that ball, Tharanga bunts it down. A maiden for Ash.
This ball's given more air, blocked off the front foot.
Floated delivery outside off, played to covers.
Fired in on his pads, played straight to square leg.
Tossed up around middle, blocked off the back foot.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, driven to mid on.
Length ball around off, defended from the crease.
Fuller ball outside off angling in to the batsman, he decides to leave it alone.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Another bouncer immediately. This time the opener ducks under it comfortably.
Karunaratne has taken a blow near his shoulder and is in a lot of pain. The physio comes in to attend him. Hope he is alright.
Nasty! A bouncer around off and middle, Karunaratne ducks under that. The ball hits him on his shoulder and goes to the keeper. He looks to be in some pain.
Length ball outside off, Dimuth looks to drive through the off side, but gets it off the inside part of his bat, back towards the bowler.
FOUR! Flighted ball outside off, Tharanga drives it powerfully through covers for a boundary.
Another floated ball, blocked onto the ground.
Some more air given on middle, defended off the front foot. Ashwin thought it to be pad first and put in an appeal. But the ball had hit the bat. The umpire stayed unmoved.
Flighted ball, blocked from the crease.
Floated delivery in line of the stumps, blocked by Tharanga.
Tossed up around off and middle, defended on to the ground.
R Ashwin will bowl from the other end.
A tad fuller outside off, left unharmed.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Length ball around off and middle, the opener get an inside edge on to his pads. But the Indians appeal to no avail.
FOUR! Timed perfectly. Length ball on middle and leg, Karunaratne flicks it wide of mid on and the ball races away to the fence.
Length ball on his pads, tucked away to the right of fine leg for a brace.
Starts from round the wicket and bowls it full outside off. Karunaratne drives it to the right of mid off for no run.
